name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, and arms ready in front for balance.
Brace your core and keep your chest lifted.
Bend your hips and knees together and sit between your feet as far as you can keep your heels down and torso steady.
Drive evenly through your midfoot and heels to extend your hips and knees back to standing.
tips: Keep your heels planted flat and track your knees in line with your toes.
Maintain a neutral spine rather than rounding your lower back at the bottom.
